```artifact
Feature: Services within Padmavathi Hospital Zone

  Scenario: Patients register for appointments within the specified zone
  Given the hospital is within a 25 sqkm radius of Padmavathi or specified PinCodes
  When a patient resides in the zone
  Then they should be able to register for an appointment

  Examples:
    | Patient Location | Result |
    | Within 25 sqkm | Success |
    | Outside 25 sqkm | Failure |

  Scenario: Chemist operations within the zone
  Given there is one authorized chemist per PinCode
  When a chemist operates within the zone
  Then they should be able to deliver medicines and collect payments

  Examples:
    | Chemist Location | Result |
    | Within PinCode | Success |
    | Outside PinCode | Failure |

  Scenario: Prescription routing to chemist
  Given a patient's pincode matches a chemist's pincode
  When a prescription is routed
  Then it should match the correct chemist

  Examples:
    | Patient Pincode | Chemist Pincode | Result |
    | Match | Match | Success |
    | Match | No Match | Failure |

  Scenario: Chemist delivery and marking
  Given a chemist delivers medicines
  When they mark the prescription
  Then the marking should indicate completion

  Examples:
    | Delivery Status | Marking Status | Result |
    | Delivered | Completed | Success |
    | Not Delivered | Not Completed | Failure |

  Scenario: Laboratory operations within the zone
  Given there is one authorized laboratory per PinCode or for the entire zone
  When a laboratory operates
  Then they should be able to conduct tests

  Examples:
    | Laboratory Location | Result |
    | Within PinCode | Success |
    | Outside PinCode | Failure |

```
